name: UFW Status
description:
Top-panel UFW firewall status: active or inactive, default incoming/outgoing policies when available, and a short rules snapshot. Can open gufw or firewall-config if installed.

Runs the system ufw binary as a non-privileged status query (read-only). If that is not permitted, falls back to reading /etc/ufw/ufw.conf. Does not enable or disable the firewall and does not run privileged helpers. No network access and no telemetry.

Clipboard access: optional "Copy status command" writes `sudo ufw status verbose` to the clipboard only when you click it. No automatic clipboard reading.
